Use-case & requirements (from notes / eng):
- Workload: in-app onboarding copilots that run multi-step guided flows; heavy use of tool calling (app state reads/writes) and streaming responses for perceived latency.
- Latency SLO: target 200-300ms p50, p95 target < 300-350ms for streaming segments; fallbacks to smaller model must hold p95 < 500ms.
- Throughput: bursts aligned with product onboarding flows — short-lived spikes (concurrent sessions 300-800 during peak).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high. Want token cost caps per monthly active user (budgeting constraint). Pilot target: average token spend <= $0.60 MRC (monthly) per 1k MAUs; engineering asked for examples of batching / caching to hit targets.
- Model preference: open models with tool-calling and quantized variants; willing to consider Redwood-verified variants if latency predictable.
- Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to cheaper model on Dedicated if capacity constrained; deterministic routing rules for premium users.
- Security: SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logging, retention controls; EU residency for some customers.

- Week 2: Latency profiling with synthetic traffic, instrument prefix cache, measure p95.
